name: callback-coordinator
title: Callback Coordinator
description: Consent-first callback triage engine that gates a callback request against quiet hours and do-not-call flags, places one CALL-E call to learn why the person needs a callback, classifies the outcome into a fail-closed disposition, and routes it to a team.
side_effects: Creates exactly one outbound CALL-E phone call per executed intake when the gate passes, the intake records recipient consent, --confirm-consent is passed, and CALLE_API_KEY is set.
Performs no network access in preview mode (the default).
credentials: CALL-E API key read from the CALLE_API_KEY environment variable, used only in execute mode.
safety: Requires explicit --confirm-consent and a recorded consent in the intake before any live call.
Skips calls during quiet hours (recipient local time) and for do_not_call=true intakes.
Uses a stable idempotency key derived from the workflow id to prevent duplicate calls.
Fail-closed disposition: ambiguous, low-confidence, wrong-person, unconfirmed-consent, unknown-reason, and lookup-error outcomes route to a human instead of a success branch.
Masks phone numbers in previews and removes phone-like text from evidence output.
Excludes transcripts and provider evidence that may contain personal data.
